verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Gmail is an email client. However, the evidence only shows the reverse direction: Gmail can be added to other clients such as Outlook or Thunderbird through IMAP/POP/SMTP. Nothing shows Gmail itself connecting Microsoft 365 or generic IMAP accounts into a unified workspace. Delegation, which covers other people's Gmail accounts, is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
